content.text: Creation proceeds from the greater to the lesser, from the center outward, in patterns that repeat at every scale. The energies moving from intelligent infinity create patterns which, in holographic style, appear as the entire creation no matter which direction is explored.

As energies move in increasingly intelligent patterns, individualized portions of infinity become {term:co-creators}. Each portion, using the intelligent infinity of which it is an inseparable part, creates its own universe — channeling love and light into intelligent energy, shaping the particular natural laws of that domain. Each universe, in turn, individualizes further, allowing greater diversity.

The hierarchy is: Infinite → Logos → sub-Logos → sub-sub-Logos → individual entity. Each level operates with creative freedom within the parameters set by the level above. No level contradicts the fundamentals. Every level adds variation.

A {term:logos} is a powerful creative principle — a focus of intelligent infinity that brings forth a galaxy under a unified set of natural laws. The Logos of this galaxy governs approximately 250 billion star systems.

The Logos holds the plan of all densities in potential completion before the first density even begins. The energy centers exist before they are manifest. The curriculum is designed before the students arrive. The Logos is the one great heart of creation at the galactic scale.

The Logos has complete free will in determining the paths of intelligent energy which promote the lessons of each density. This means the basic physical constants, the vibratory rates, the fundamental conditions of experience — all of these are choices made by the Logos. A different Logos could make different choices. The physics of a galaxy is not arbitrary, but it is chosen.

Within the guidelines of the Logos, {term:sub-logos} entities — the stars — may find various means of differentiating experiences without removing or adding to the fundamental ways established by their parent Logos. Each sun is a sub-Logos: an individualized focus of intelligent infinity governing its domain with creative freedom within galactic parameters.

The natural laws at the level of a solar system are local variations upon a galactic theme. The physics of any world is unique in its details, though universal in its foundations. Each sun is somewhat and slightly different due to its own creative choices.

The energy flow follows a sequence: galactic spiraling energy → solar spiraling energy → planetary spiraling energy → the experiential circumstances of beings on that world. At each step, the energy is further specified, further localized, but never disconnected from its source.

The differentiation does not stop at the stellar level. Each individual entity — each {term:mind-body-spirit-complex} — is itself a sub-sub-Logos: a focus of the Creator's creative principle. Even the simplest particle contains, in its entirety, the One Infinite Creator.

The difference between an individual entity and the Logos of its galaxy is one of scope, not of nature. The same creative power that shaped universes exists within every being. The same free will that set creation in motion is exercised in every decision. Every entity is a co-Creator — not by title bestowed from outside, but by the nature of what it is.
The entire creation is alive. There is no level at which existence becomes inert, mechanical, or devoid of the Creator's presence.

Light is not simply what eyes perceive or instruments measure. The light spoken of here is the vibratory distortion of infinity — intelligent, full of energy, the building block of what is known as matter.

Love creates vibration. This vibration, pure and not physical in any form, produces its first product: the photon. Pure motion condenses into the first particle. This is not merely a physical event but a metaphysical one — the first moment in which the invisible becomes, in some sense, visible.

The photon, through added vibrations and rotations, further condenses into the particles that constitute the various densities of experience. Light condenses into material through quantized incremental rotations of angular velocity, creating chemical elements and all material forms.

Light moves in a straight-line spiral, giving spirals an inevitable upward vector toward more comprehensive beingness. This spiral pattern is responsible for the shape of galaxies, solar systems, and planets — all revolving and tending toward the lenticular.

The white light emanating from each sub-Logos contains within it all the frequencies of experience, all the densities, like a prism waiting to separate into its component colors. The rays are narrow and necessary — each one a specific apportioning of intelligent energy's representation of intelligent infinity. The same patterns repeat in physical and metaphysical domains. Even crystallized minerals reflect, in their visible colors, the rays of creation.
